title_zh: 查出奖金表漏计月份并约好更正

scenario.label_zh: 核对销售增长后的奖金计算
scenario.goal_zh: 核对员工奖金表遗漏的月份，并约定更正计算后再确认应付金额

context_zh: 虚构公司工资沟通中，员工与工资专员核对奖励计算表。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: There was a boom in sales in June, but my bonus looks the same as last quarter. Could you explain the calculation?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Let me open the sheet. It should use sales from April through June.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: This total only includes April and May. June is on the next tab.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: You're right. The formula stops at May, so the figure on your statement needs checking.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Could you correct it and send me the revised breakdown before I rely on that amount?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Yes. I'll include June and send the recalculated figure for you to check. I won't guess the new total now.
